newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Joe McGrath appointed as New Zealand manager.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Joe McGrath appointed as New Zealand manager.

text.p: Joe McGrath was on Wednesday appointed manager of the New Zealand senior international soccer team, a statement from the Football Association of Ireland (FAI) said.
The FAI said it wished McGrath every success in his new position.
McGrath, the former Republic of Ireland national director of coaching, had joined the New Zealand Association as director of coaching on a four-year contract in 1996.
